label: rem:q-dimension-layer-remark
title: What the q-dimension layer retains
html: The layer preserves the per-irrep structure that the Markov trace normally collapses. It provides the high-fidelity projection data required to map force-carrier knots into exact Wedderburn components. For example, it extracts the [9]_q and [10]_q q-dimensions for the Bring torus-knot force carriers directly from the character evaluations.
